environment.description: Same EC2 instance (c5.xlarge, Amazon Linux 2, 32-bit compiled binary) in a private subnet with no internet gateway or NAT gateway route. Service is exposed exclusively through an interface VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy restricting access to principals within the owning AWS Organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). The VPC endpoint's associated security group permits inbound TCP/8080 only from CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 (internal VPC range). Additionally, the endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning each connecting VPC endpoint must be manually approved. The instance's own security group references the VPC endpoint security group as the sole allowed source (sg-0abc123def456 inbound rule). No public IP, no EIP, no IGW, no NAT, no VPC peering to external accounts. Route table for the subnet contains only local VPC route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and the S3 gateway endpoint prefix list for patching.

config.subnet: private subnet, no IGW, no NAT, no peering
